attrs.evidence: Three sites holding x≠y, y≠z, z≠x over |D|=2 — an odd cycle of disequalities, i.e. a 2-colouring of K₃.
attrs.finding: REFUTED. There is a federation whose every site is locally satisfiable, whose every pairwise overlap is consistent, and whose union has no model. Aggregation fidelity does not hold in its universal form.
attrs.prior_art: Standard; the sheaf reading is Abramsky–Brandenburger 2011 (local sections agreeing on overlaps need not glue).
attrs.statement: For every federation, if every site is locally satisfiable and every pairwise overlap is consistent, then the union has a model.
